# Second Fixture Classifier, first edition

A second test fixture, deliberately disagreeing with the first. It exists to prove
that two classifiers coexist in the corpus rather than being reconciled into one
answer. Every gene symbol is invented.

## Section 1 — Entity definition

GENEA mutation defines Fixture Entity One at any blast count. No blast threshold
applies under this classifier.

## Section 3 — Follow-up marker

The GENEA mutation is a validated fixture follow-up marker and should be tracked
with a high-sensitivity assay.
